Development preview. TriSpeech does not require an account and does not provide cloud history backup. Recordings, transcripts, settings, and downloaded models are stored locally on this device. Removing the app or clearing its data removes that local information.

Offline Whisper processes audio on the device. Android Native STT follows your device’s speech-service settings. When you choose GPT-4o Mini Online, the selected audio is uploaded to the TriSpeech backend and sent to TokenMix for cloud transcription. Temporary backend audio is deleted after a successful result or within 24 hours after a terminal failure.

Start.io rewarded ads can unlock GPT-4o Mini online transcription. Start.io processes device and advertising data to deliver ads and prevent fraud. You can change ad personalization under Online access → Privacy choices. TriSpeech keeps anonymous installation, reward, credit, and job records on its backend. There are no payments or subscriptions. Do not upload confidential audio or material you do not have permission to process. You can delete individual recordings and downloaded models inside the app.

TriSpeech is currently a development preview and is provided without payment. Features may change, fail, or be temporarily unavailable. Native STT and Offline Whisper run independently from the online preview service.

You are responsible for recordings and files you process and must have permission to use them. Do not use the service for unlawful, abusive, or harmful activity. Online use may be limited by file size, duration, request rate, provider availability, and development cost controls.

Keep copies of important data. Local history can be lost if the app is removed, its data is cleared, or the device fails. Continued use means you accept these preview terms.

TriSpeech includes open-source software and downloadable model files. Their copyright notices and license texts must be packaged with the production build. Model licenses and source-attribution files remain applicable even though downloads and offline processing are free.
Offline Whisper and its downloadable models are free. Audio stays on this device while it is transcribed locally.
Microphone permission is required to record.

Your audio is uploaded to the TriSpeech development backend and processed by TokenMix using GPT-4o Mini. The TokenMix key stays on the server and is not included in the app. Temporary uploads are deleted after success or within 24 hours after a terminal failure. Offline Whisper processes audio locally.

TriSpeech is still under development and this is not the final release. Some online services may be unavailable or change while testing. If the app is useful to you, you can optionally support continued development.
Enjoying TriSpeech? If it has been useful, you can optionally support continued development. Every transcription feature remains free.
